# What will your private pilot license really cost, in total and per extra hour?

> Free private pilot license cost calculator: flight hours, aircraft rental, instructor time, exam fees and gear become a total cost, a monthly budget, the price of each extra hour and a flying club versus renting comparison. Private, runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/private-pilot-training-cost-calculator/)
